alex: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
alex: Did: final review of the canary rollout doc, merged endpoint throttling fix, replied to PM questions about routing policy.
alex: Blockers: waiting on eng-infra for Dedicated capacity smoke tests (no dedicated test GPU in staging yet) and need design signoff on the model-card updates.
alex: Today: coordinate with infra for test access window, prep the release notes, and add the short VPC+KMS example requested by PM.

maria: Thanks — I can take the model-card signoff. Will paste the suggested copy here in a sec.

jordan: On infra, I filed a priority request with eng-infra and pinged @sam and @infra-bot.

sam: @jordan saw it. Moving to high priority — scheduling an access window 3–4pm PT today. Will post temporary creds here once rotated.

maria: Pasted diff for model-card: small tweak on data retention + added an example env var. @alex @pm-lee please review.

pm-lee: Quick read — LGTM on retention copy. One ask: can we add a tiny snippet showing VPC + KMS flow? Not required for canary but useful for enterprise docs.

alex: Good call — I'll add a short snippet and link to the private deployment guide. Also, can reviewers please check this blocking PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/412 — contains the throttling fix we merged but needs review for rollout flags.

jordan: Reviewing PR now, will try to ship minor nits by EOD.

sam: Infra creds posted in a secure note: `staging-dedicated-access-2026-03` (rotated token). DM me if you can't reach the cluster.

alex: Thanks. Prioritization question: feature-X (nonblocking UX polish) — do we hard-stop it for launch or ship post-launch? My vote: defer to post-launch to reduce scope.

maria: Agree, defer feature-X. Keeps the canary narrowly focused and reduces rollback surface.

pm-lee: Agreed. I'll mark the roadmap ticket as post-launch and update the timeline.

alex: Cool — I'll update the roadmap doc and add a condensed canary checklist to the release notes. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy scheduled for 2026-03-17T22:00Z — canary gates: latency < 120ms, error rate < 0.5%.

jordan: Noted. I'll monitor traces and set a temporary dashboard for the window. Will alert on the channel if we breach thresholds.

sam: All set from infra side for the access window and smoke tests. Post results here.

alex: Nothing else from me. Thanks everyone — cc @oncall for visibility.

oncall: Acknowledged — will watch overnight and escalate if necessary.
